competitors.name: Dance and Dance Studio
competitors.offering: Bollywood, Hip Hop, Zumba fitness, freestyle and weekend dance workshops for adults; the site says it teaches ages 14 to 60 and has regular classes plus weekend workshops.
competitors.schedule: Weekday evening batch 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM; Zumba classes Tuesdays and Thursdays 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM; weekend workshops mentioned on site.
competitors.fit_reason: It is a Chennai dance studio offering adult Bollywood, hip hop and dance-fitness classes in the same after-work and weekend use case as the founder’s plan.

competitors.name: Unitedbydance Community
competitors.offering: Studio-based dance classes for adults, women and children; the page explicitly lists Bollywood, Hip-Hop, Contemporary and locking, plus weekday evening, weekend and early-morning adult batches.
competitors.schedule: Adults: Monday and Wednesday 8:00 PM to 9:00 PM; Saturday 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM; Sunday 12:00 noon to 1:00 PM; early-morning working-adult batch Tuesday and Thursday 8:00 AM to 9:00 AM.
competitors.fit_reason: It serves working adults in Chennai with adult evening and weekend dance batches in Bollywood, hip-hop and related styles, so it competes directly for the same customer segment.

competitors.name: Zenith Dance Academy
competitors.offering: Professional dance course packages covering Bollywood, hip hop, contemporary, belly, parkour and dance workout; packages are sold as class bundles and include evening-batch timing notes.
competitors.schedule: Evening batch timing is noted as 1 hour only; class frequency is sold as 2, 3, 5 or 6 days/week packages.
competitors.fit_reason: It sells packaged dance classes in Bollywood and hip hop, including workout-oriented formats, which overlaps with evening/weekend classes for working adults.

competitors.name: Dance Off Dance and Fitness Studio
competitors.offering: Kids and adult dance classes, choreography, workshops and fitness-oriented dance formats; Instagram posts mention Bollywood, hip-hop, contemporary, salsa and adult batches.
competitors.schedule: Adult batch timing is not fully shown in the source snippet; the studio’s Instagram positions it as an adults batch with fitness-oriented classes.
competitors.fit_reason: It is a Chennai dance-and-fitness studio actively marketing adult Bollywood and hip-hop classes, so it competes for the same working-professional audience.

competitors.name: RAACK Academy of Dance
competitors.offering: Adult dance classes with Bollywood and hip-hop style content; Instagram search result mentions an introductory offer for adults and the studio brand is positioned for dance classes in Chennai.
competitors.schedule: Adult intermediate batch every Tuesday and Thursday at 8:00 PM; first 2 classes free.
competitors.fit_reason: It offers adult evening dance batches in Chennai with an introductory monthly price, competing for the same after-work learner segment.

market_price_context.summary: UrbanPro lists the average fee for dance classes in Chennai at Rs. 400 - 500 per month.
UrbanPro’s hip-hop dance classes page shows monthly fee guidance of INR 3,600 - INR 7,200 for a 12-class pattern and says the fee varies between online and offline classes.
UrbanPro’s Bollywood dance classes page shows an average price of INR 450/hr total and says the fee charged varies between online and offline classes.
Justdial’s Chennai Bollywood dance classes page says fees depend on class duration, trainer experience, batch size, studio facilities, and course level, rather than giving one fixed city price.
